title: Widest Pair Of Indices With Equal Range Sum
description: Find the maximum distance (j - i) between two indices such that the sum of elements in subarray nums1[0...i] equals nums2[0...j].
pseudocode:
1. map = {0: -1}
2. sum1 = 0, sum2 = 0, maxDist = 0
3. for i = 0 to n-1:
4.   sum1 += nums1[i], sum2 += nums2[i]
5.   diff = sum1 - sum2
6.   if diff in map:
7.     maxDist = max(maxDist, i - map[diff])
8.   else:
9.     map[diff] = i

steps.note: Initialize hash map with sum 0 at index -1
Calculate sums for index 0: sum1=1, sum2=0, diff=1
Store diff 1 in map at index 0
Calculate sums for index 1: sum1=3, sum2=2, diff=1
